title: Angular / Ionic Build
description: Full build pipeline for Angular and Ionic apps: encrypt-env → nx build → strip-exif → inject-meta, with optional leak check, source-map guard, comment and console stripping, CSP nonce and SRI hash.

outputPath.description: Output directory relative to repo root (e.g. dist/apps/web).

envProject.description: Folder name under environments/ that contains this project's env files.

env.description: Pipeline env (DEV, UAT, PROD or custom, e.g. QA). Always set via Nx configurations.

buildTarget.description: Angular build target to run, "<project>:<target>". Default: "<this project>:build".

buildConfiguration.description: Configuration of buildTarget. Default: PROD → production, UAT → uat, otherwise development.

secure.description: Write the CSP nonce placeholder into the served index.html (and the other nonce.files); nothing under assets/ is touched.

nonce.description: secure: how the nonce placeholder is written. Defaults keep the standard markup; set them to match an existing server setup.

placeholder.description: What the server replaces per request. Default: <!--#echo var="CSP_NONCE" --> (what pstack csp configures).

tags.description: all (default): every script, style and stylesheet link. legacy: inline scripts (no src), every link and every style.

position.description: Where the nonce attribute goes in a tag (default end).

replaceTokens.description: Text replaced by the placeholder anywhere in the page, e.g. ["random-csp-nonce"]. The build fails when a token sits in quotes the placeholder also uses.

files.description: Pages to rewrite, relative to the served root (default ["index.html"]); never under assets/.

stripHtmlComments.description: Every env: remove HTML comments from the served index.html (and the other nonce.files). SSI directives and IE conditional comments stay.

sri.description: Integrity (SHA-384) for every chunk: passed to the Angular build as --subresource-integrity, and the hashes are refreshed after strip/obfuscate. With cipher aes-gcm the runtime refuses to decrypt when a script has no integrity attribute.

harden.description: Replaced: read as stripComments: true and dropConsole: [log, debug, warn] when those are unset. Runs no script.

leakCheck.description: non-DEV: plaintext of encrypted env values in the output fails the build, is listed, or is not checked. LEAK_CHECK overrides it for one run. Default: off.

sourceMaps.description: non-DEV: .map files or sourceMappingURL comments in the output fail the build, are listed, or are not checked. Default: off.

stripComments.description: non-DEV: remove comments from the built JS, CSS and served HTML (assets/ untouched). Needs terser in the workspace for JS.

dropConsole.description: non-DEV: console methods whose calls are removed from the built JS (needs terser in the workspace).

obfuscate.description: non-DEV: obfuscate the app's own JS (main and lazy chunks; runtime, polyfills, vendor, scripts and styles are skipped). light ≈ +20% gzip, medium ≈ +67%, strong also encodes the strings of the chunk holding the decrypt code and flattens its control flow. Needs javascript-obfuscator in the workspace. Default: off.

obfuscateOptions.description: non-DEV: javascript-obfuscator options on top of the obfuscate preset, e.g. { "stringArrayThreshold": 0.3 }. Options that need eval, lock domains, rename globals or properties, or change the target cannot be set.

baseHref.description: URL base href forwarded to the Angular builder (e.g. /my-app/).

keySplit.description: aes-gcm: random key shares in the meta tag and bundle, or also in a fetched asset.

domains.description: aes-gcm: hosts this build may run on (set per configuration). Empty: no lock.

onMismatch.description: On a host not in domains: decrypt nothing (block) or only warn.
